---
name: Ticket
about: One unit of work in the ship-loop format (skills/ship-loop/SKILL.md, step 1)
---

Say what is wrong in one or two sentences, with a real example.

Run each command in this ticket in the terminal where the work will run, and paste its output.

## Reproduction

The literal commands, and the wrong output they give today.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A criterion that is objectively true or false, e.g. "exit code 0 on 12 rows".

## Verification

The commands that prove the work is done, literally, to paste.

## Mutation check

Expected or not expected. If expected: which revert or edit must make which command fail.
